description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh:
多云的code。取值：
- qcloud：腾讯云。
- aliyun：阿里云。
- hcloud：华为云。
description.en:
The code for the multicloud environment. Valid values:

- qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

- hcloud: Huawei Cloud.

description.zh:
数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。
可调用[DescribeDataSourceInstance](~~2639736~~)获取数据源ID。
description.en:
The ID of the data source. The threat analysis feature generates this ID by calculating an MD5 hash of the parameters.
Call the [DescribeDataSourceInstance](~~2639736~~) operation to obtain the data source ID.

description.zh: 数据源参数详情，json数组格式。
description.en: The details of the data source parameters, in a JSON array format.

description.zh:
数据源类型。取值：
 - obs：华为云obs。
 - wafApi：腾讯云waf下载api。 
 - ckafka： 腾讯云ckafka。
description.en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

- obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS).

- wafApi: Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF) download API.

- ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka.

description.zh: 日志ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。可调用[ListDataSourceLogs](~~2639707~~)获取日志ID。
description.en: The ID of the log. The threat analysis feature generates this ID by calculating an MD5 hash of the parameters. Call the [ListDataSourceLogs](~~2639707~~) operation to obtain the log ID.

description.zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
- cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
- ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
description.en:
The region where the Data Management hub is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloud-siem modify-data-source-log --log-code cloud_siem_waf_xxxxx --account-id 123xxxxxxx --data-source-type obs --data-source-instance-id ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --data-source-instance-logs LogCode_:_cloud_siem_qcloud_waf_alert_log_,_LogParas_:_ParaCode_:_api_name_,_ParaValue_:_GetAttackDownloadRecords --log-instance-id ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloud-siem ModifyDataSourceLog --region cn-hangzhou --DataSourceInstanceLogs 'LogCode_:_cloud_siem_qcloud_waf_alert_log_,_LogParas_:_ParaCode_:_api_name_,_ParaValue_:_GetAttackDownloadRecords' --CloudCode hcloud --LogInstanceId ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1 --AccountId 123xxxxxxx --DataSourceType obs --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --LogCode cloud_siem_waf_xxxxx --DataSourceInstanceId ef33097c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca320pkl1
